senses.gloss: f. (popular corruption of lectica; for the prefixed guttural cmp. laena and χλαῖνα, lectum and κλίνη; v. Liddell & Scott’s Greek Dict. s. lit. Γ)

units: Cant. R. to V, 5; Koh. R. to IX, 11 אפי׳ בגלק׳ לא וכ׳ could not even be carried in a lectica.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:8">Cant. R. to IV, 8</cite> <he>בכל קדיקה</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 838:1">Yalk. Ps. 838</cite> <he>כל קרקיא</he> (read <he>בִּכְלֶקְדִּיקָא</he>).

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 838:1">Ib.</cite> Lev. 666 <he>שלא יטייל אחריך בגלטק׳</he>; Sifra B’har Par. 5, ch. VII … <he>יטול … בלנטיא</he>) he (the Hebrew servant) shall not walk behind thee when thou art carried in the lectica, v. <cite ref="L00682"><he>לֶקְטִיקָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 37:12">Sifré Deut. 37</cite> <cite ref="C00863"><he>גלגוטיקא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 238">Yalk. Kings 238</cite> <cite ref="C00891"><he>גלוגיקא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 15:24">Targ. Job XV, 24</cite> <he>איטימוס לגלוגדיקא</he> Ar. ed. Koh. (ed. <he>לגלוגדק</he>) ready for the bier (for death, cmp. LXX).
Targ. Y. Ex. XXIV, 10 אתקניה גְּלוּגְדַּק וכ׳ (גִּיל׳ some ed.) made the sapphire brick a foot-stool in place of the hypopodion &c.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 2:1">Targ. Lam. II, 1</cite> <he>גלוגדקא דרגלוהי</he> (h. text <he>הדום רגליו</he>).
